contract.original_request_text: Is Redis single-threaded for command execution? Cite the docs.

answer_text: Redis is single-threaded for command execution [s1], so a single slow command can block the others until it completes.

sources.text: Redis is single-threaded for command execution, though it uses background threads for some operations such as unlink and AOF rewrite.

claims.quoted_span: Redis is single-threaded for command execution
